# Keyboard shortcuts

The keys the app binds before you change anything: 38. Each one runs a command, and works only where its context holds. Change them in `keybindings.json`, which **Preferences: Open Keyboard Shortcuts (JSON)** opens; a plugin can add its own.

## Contexts

| Context | When it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `editor` | The editor has focus, in either input mode. |
| `vim.normal` | Vim mode is on and the engine is in normal mode. |
| `vim.insert` | Vim mode is on and the engine is in insert mode. |
| `mode.desktop` | The editor has focus and vim mode is off. |
| `commandBar` | The command bar is open. |
| `panel` | Focus is in a panel other than the editor, and the command bar is closed. |

## Everywhere

A key with no context works wherever focus is.

| Windows and Linux | macOS | Command | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+k` | `⌘k` | Open the command bar | `commandBar.toggle` |
| `Ctrl+Shift+v` | `⌘⇧v` | Open preview to the side | `preview.openToSide` |
| `` Ctrl+` `` (the key left of 1) | `` Ctrl` `` (the key left of 1) | Show or hide: Commands | `layout.togglePanel:commands` |
| `Ctrl+=` | `⌘=` | Zoom in | `window.zoomIn` |
| `Ctrl+-` | `⌘-` | Zoom out | `window.zoomOut` |
| `Ctrl+0` | `⌘0` | Reset zoom | `window.zoomReset` |

## editor

The editor has focus, in either input mode.

| Windows and Linux | macOS | Command | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+s` | `⌘s` | Save | `editor.save` |
| `Ctrl+Shift+o` | `⌘⇧o` | Go to Block… | `editor.goToBlock` |
| `Alt+Shift+f` | `⌥⇧f` | Format Brief | `editor.formatBrief` |

## mode.desktop

The editor has focus and vim mode is off.

| Windows and Linux | macOS | Command | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+z` | `⌘z` | Undo | `editor.undo` |
| `Ctrl+y` | `⌘⇧z` | Redo | `editor.redo` |
| `Ctrl+Shift+z` | `Ctrl⇧z` | Redo | `editor.redo` |
| `Ctrl+f` | `⌘f` | Find | `editor.find` |
| `Ctrl+g` | `⌘g` | Find: next | `editor.findNext` |
| `Ctrl+Shift+g` | `⌘⇧g` | Find: previous | `editor.findPrevious` |
| `Ctrl+Alt+g` | `⌘⌥g` | Go to line | `editor.gotoLine` |
| `Ctrl+n` | `⌘n` | New brief | `document.new` |
| `Ctrl+o` | `⌘o` | Open… | `editor.open` |
| `Ctrl+Shift+s` | `⌘⇧s` | Save as… | `editor.saveAs` |
| `Ctrl+w` | `⌘w` | Close the tab | `document.close` |
| `Ctrl+r` | `⌘r` | Reload the window | `window.reload` |
| `Ctrl+PageDown` | `⌘PageDown` | Next tab | `document.next` |
| `Ctrl+PageUp` | `⌘PageUp` | Previous tab | `document.previous` |
| `Ctrl+Shift+PageUp` | `⌘⇧PageUp` | Move tab left | `editor.moveTabLeft` |
| `Ctrl+Shift+PageDown` | `⌘⇧PageDown` | Move tab right | `editor.moveTabRight` |
| `Ctrl+\` | `⌘\` | Split editor right | `editor.splitRight` |
| `Ctrl+Shift+\` | `⌘⇧\` | Split editor down | `editor.splitDown` |
| `Ctrl+Alt+ArrowLeft` | `⌘⌥ArrowLeft` | Focus previous editor group | `editor.focusPreviousGroup` |
| `Ctrl+Alt+ArrowRight` | `⌘⌥ArrowRight` | Focus next editor group | `editor.focusNextGroup` |
| `Ctrl+1` | `⌘1` | Tab: 1 | `document.select:1` |
| `Ctrl+2` | `⌘2` | Tab: 2 | `document.select:2` |
| `Ctrl+3` | `⌘3` | Tab: 3 | `document.select:3` |
| `Ctrl+4` | `⌘4` | Tab: 4 | `document.select:4` |
| `Ctrl+5` | `⌘5` | Tab: 5 | `document.select:5` |
| `Ctrl+6` | `⌘6` | Tab: 6 | `document.select:6` |
| `Ctrl+7` | `⌘7` | Tab: 7 | `document.select:7` |
| `Ctrl+8` | `⌘8` | Tab: 8 | `document.select:8` |
| `Ctrl+9` | `⌘9` | Tab: 9 | `document.select:9` |
